safety.confirm_process_kill: Are you sure you want to stop process PID {pid}?
safety.confirm_power: Are you sure you want to RESTART or SHUT DOWN the system?
safety.confirm_shell: Do you authorize running this shell command: `{command}`?
safety.confirm_generic: Sensitive action detected: `{action}`. Do you authorize execution?
ack.work_started: Understood, it is started and I will update you with the result.
reply.canceled_sensitive_action: Understood. I canceled the pending sensitive action.
reply.waiting_approval_yes_no: This worker is waiting for approval. Reply with 'yes' to approve or 'no' to deny.
reply.decision_forwarded: Acknowledged. I sent your decision to the running worker.
reply.step_budget_exceeded: Sorry, I could not process your request after the current step budget.
reply.no_plan_resolved: I could not conclude safely from this context. I can retry with a different strategy if you want.
reply.voice_rephrase: I did not fully catch that. Could you repeat it in one short sentence?
reply.unknown_action_template: Action '{action_id}' does not exist in the current runtime. Nearby suggestions: {suggestions}. Please rephrase with more context.
reply.error_during_processing: Sorry, there was an error during processing: {details}
reply.technical_issue: Sorry, I had a technical issue while processing your request: {details}
reply.session_busy: I already have a running task in this session. Please wait for it to finish or cancel it before starting a new one.
reply.media_busy_takeover_prompt: Media control is still busy with another task. Do you want me to force-cancel the previous task and take over now?
reply.media_takeover_cancelled: Understood. I kept the current media task and did not take over.
reply.media_takeover_started: Done. I forced takeover from the previous media task and started your new request.
reply.worker_session_missing: I could not continue because this worker has no valid parent session. Please start from an existing session.
reply.approval_target_missing: I could not request approval because the owner session is missing. Please restart this task from your active session.
reply.loop_stuck: I am stuck on action '{action_id}' with no real progress. Please refine the goal or allow a different strategy.
reply.loop_stuck_recover: Repeated action detected in {action_id}; consolidating the latest valid result.
reply.media_control_manual: Could not control media automatically. Please adjust manually.
